messages.text: Where is my order? email (email hidden)

Jeremy, your two B30s still haven't shipped. Shop···· and Shop···· are both paid and still set to ship November 15.

Each order already has its Power K. set aside for it at our Tennessee warehouse. They're just waiting for the B30 units to arrive there. You'll get tracking by email as soon as each one ships.

You can follow that batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Is there anything else you want me to check?

The carrier isn't assigned yet, Jeremy. Our warehouse picks it when it prints the shipping label, so neither order has a carrier on it right now.

The B30s we've already shipped from our Tennessee warehouse went out with FedEx and needed a signature on delivery, so yours will probably go the same way. Your tracking email will confirm the carrier and include the tracking link as soon as each order ships.
checking on my order please Sarah
Handed to the team · The Nov 15 date has passed and there's no new date on the order or in the facts.

Jeremy, one of your B30s is on its way. Order Shop···· left our Tennessee warehouse yesterday, with the B30 and its Power K. in the same box. It's due Thursday, November 18: (tracking link hidden)

Your second B30, Shop····, hasn't shipped yet, and I'm sorry because it missed the November 15 date. Its Power K. is already set aside, and it's waiting on the next B30 units to reach the warehouse. I've asked the team for its new ship date, and someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email.
You're welcome, Jeremy. Before you go, one quick question. On the 2nd you were set on a Thor P2 and a third B30, but neither order went through. What made you hold off?
